description:
Use Eclipse's refactoring feature to rename a Java class. The project files are at ~/eclipse-workspace/refactor-demo/.

The project contains a class named 'OldClassName' in the com.example.demo package, which is used by Main.java.

Your task:
1. Import the Maven project from ~/eclipse-workspace/refactor-demo/ into Eclipse
2. Use Eclipse's Refactor > Rename feature to rename 'OldClassName' to 'NewClassName'
3. Ensure all references to the class are updated automatically
4. Verify the project still compiles after refactoring

Note: Using Eclipse's refactoring feature (rather than manual find/replace) ensures that all references, imports, and the filename are updated correctly.
